answer: Sybil defense: bind each identity to one hardware root plus a slashable bond. A new agent registers a unique ferrous token and locks collateral; one token buys one vote, so extra wallets change nothing. Random audits trace votes to tokens and funding sources, and any cluster sharing a root is slashed, losing its bond and future payouts. To reach the zenith of influence with N fakes, an attacker needs N physical tokens and N locked bonds, and one detection wipes them all. A sable blacklist of burned roots then blocks reuse, so cost grows per fake identity.
